title: Allied Fast Boom
openingSummary: POWR>TENT>PROC>PROC; defend and scout; WEAP>DOME>FIX; add a second WEAP only after income stabilizes.
when: Rush distance is long, multiple ore fields exist, and no all-in force is known.
avoidWhen: A pre-vehicle rush or repeated harvester pressure is already visible.
opening: POWR, then TENT with 3 E1 scouts
PROC #1 then PROC #2 quickly — each brings a free harvester
WEAP > DOME > FIX; keep POWR ahead of the drain
Second WEAP only after income is stable; ATEK -> GPS late
composition: 4-5 harvesters on two refineries — the whole strategy is this line
8-12 2TNK as the core once the boom stands; 5 E3 for AA
execution: queueMission sweep early and wide — a boom without eyes dies to the first all-in
Foot raiders: crush them with the harvester; vehicles: let it flee
queueMission strike posture=raid targetPriority=economy with the JEEPs while booming — trade their income for yours
pursue on enemyRetreating; reinforce the front with every fresh pair

phases.name: expand
phases.objective: Establish two refineries while maintaining scouting and a minimal defensive screen.

phases.name: convert
phases.objective: Convert the income lead into parallel vehicle production and sustained pressure.

abortTransitions.when: A material force arrives before vehicle production or harvesters are repeatedly denied.

claims.statement: A refinery provides a harvester and is the core ore-processing structure.
Low power slows production by a factor of three.
Additional production buildings reduce build time for their queue with diminishing returns.
A second refinery and later second factory trade opening defense for stronger sustained production.
Cancel the expansion sequence when an early all-in is confirmed and buy the nearest valid counter.
Spend a proven income lead on production and army rather than accumulating idle cash.
